AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S1797

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the tax law, in relation to authorizing the county of
Washington to impose hotel or motel taxes


 PURPOSE :
To authorize Washington County to impose hotel or motel taxes.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section one - adds a new section 1202-aa to authorize Washington
County to adopt and amend local laws imposing a hotel or motel tax at
a rate of four percent

Section two - contains the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :
This legislation has been introduced at the request of the Washington
County Board of Supervisors titter a recommendation of the
Agriculture, Planning, Tourism and Community Development Committee.
The occupancy tax would be imposed on bed and breakfasts, inns,
housekeeping cottages with four or more units and tourist facilities
at a rate of four percent. This definition is consistent with the
state sales tax on occupancy.

The County will use the revenues generated by this tax to promote
tourism in. preserve the heritage of: and celebrate the agricultural
community in, Washington County.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None to the State.

 LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
It is anticipated that the occupancy tax will generate $30,000 per
year.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

A.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S1797A        REVISED 06/02/09

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the tax law, in relation to authorizing the county of
Washington to impose hotel or motel taxes


 PURPOSE :
To authorize Washington County to impose hotel or motel taxes.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section one - adds a new section 1202-aa to authorize Washington
County to adopt and amend local laws imposing a hotel or motel tax at
a rate of one half of one percent, any whole percent or any
combination of a whole percent and one-half of one percent; provided
that such rates shall not exceed four percent

Section two - contains the effective date

 JUSTIFICATION :
This legislation has been introduced at the request of the Washington
County Board of Supervisors after a recommendation of the Agriculture,
Planning, Tourism and Community Development Committee. The occupancy
tax would be imposed on bed and breakfasts, inns, housekeeping
cottages with four or more units and tourist facilities at a rate of
four percent. This definition is consistent with the state sales tax
on occupancy.

The County will use the revenues generated by this tax to promote
tourism in, preserve the heritage of, and celebrate the agricultural
community in, Washington County.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None to the State.

 LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
It is anticipated that the occupancy tax will generate $30,000 per
year.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
